confounds: Diagnosed users were more active: approximately 649 versus 530 retained posts per user, with the diagnosed group higher in every fold. Raw post counts and full-timeline prevalence are therefore exposure-sensitive.
The corpus may encode self-disclosure or annotation practices around mental-health language; explicit treatment and diagnosis vocabulary should not be treated as causal or clinically diagnostic.
Portuguese orthography, slang, reflexive pronouns, possessives, and ambiguous negation create lexicon errors; quotation, lyrics, advocacy, news, and third-person heuristics are incomplete.
Unknown demographic, age, gender, fandom, and platform-style differences may drive pronoun use, laughter, punctuation, social vocabulary, and emotional expressivity.
No timestamps were available for temporal analysis, so past/future markers reflect language rather than longitudinal orientation.
Class imbalance remains substantial: 619 diagnosed and 5463 control users, despite similar label composition across development folds.

caveats: Pronouns and possessives are ambiguous in informal Portuguese.
All users had at least 50 retained posts; first-50 estimates reduce prolific-user bias but do not remove selection effects.
findings.evidence_summary: The singular gap was positive in every fold (+7.6 to +10.3 pp); the plural difference favored controls in every fold.
findings.prompt_guidance: Use self-focus as a contextual feature and prefer per-user rates; combine it with affect or modality rather than treating pronouns as diagnostic.

negative_results: Absolutist language was weak: 8.8% vs 8.4% of first-50 posts, with one fold reversing direction.
A broad hopelessness lexicon showed no reliable difference: 0.9% vs 0.9% of first-50 posts.
Certainty markers were essentially equal (about 2.1% vs 2.1%) with mixed fold directions.
Explicit loneliness/isolating vocabulary was rare and unstable after equal-exposure control.
Quotation markers were slightly more common in controls; lyric markers were only marginally higher in diagnosed users, and self-plus-mental-state/lyric overlap was tiny.
